title: The Pastry Makers Who Planned Bimbo After Ten at Night
conflicts: Starting headcount: Servitje's account (Cherem, 2008) has Velasco hiring 19 production workers; Grupo Bimbo and Forbes say 34 employees; the story gives both with attribution. Father's death 1936 (Cherem) vs 1937 (Forbes, Grupo Bimbo, El Financiero): the story says only that Lorenzo was eighteen. Incorporation 4 July 1944 (Cherem) vs 'founded 4 July 1945' (El Financiero); the story uses the agreed opening date of 2 December 1945. Capital available given as about 375,000 and elsewhere 300,000 pesos in the same source; the story says roughly 375,000.
notes: Main source is the Expansión excerpt of Silvia Cherem's book, largely in Servitje's own words; Spanish remarks are paraphrased. The repeat screen flagged miguel-krigsner-o-boticario-pharmacy-creams-1977 as same-founder but let it through; it is a different founder and company, and no fields were reworded. Funding marked bootstrapped (partners' savings, a bank loan and family loans; one relative took 10% equity).
